about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: About
about.description: I am a computer passionate who love to create innovative digital solutions with thoughtful design, clean code and user-centered approach to satisfy the needs of users and businesses that seek to make a positive impact.
about.itSupportDescription: I specialize in providing comprehensive IT support solutions, ensuring your technology infrastructure runs smoothly and efficiently. I'm good with known Operating systems (Windows, MacOS and Linux) and other main hardware diagnostics and maintenance.
about.webDesignerDescription: I use my design skills to create visually stunning and user-friendly websites with modern design principles. I specialize in creating responsive layouts, smooth animations, and intuitive user experiences that engage and delight visitors.
about.networkAdminDescription: I design, implement, deploy, and secure robust network infrastructures for small, medium and large enterprises. I ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability for enterprise networks through expert configuration and monitoring.
about.mobileDevDescription: I develop cross-platform and native mobile applications that deliver seamless user experiences. I am proficient in React Native, Flutter, and mobile design best practices for iOS and Android.
about.otherInterestsDescription: Beyond technology, I'm passionate about exploring diverse fields that enrich my creativity and my perspective about life
